questions.explanation: Consolidating multiple GitHub organizations under a single GitHub Enterprise account enables centralized seat management. Instead of over-provisioning across isolated business units with separate subscriptions, enterprise-level seat management pools unused licenses, directly reducing wasted expenditures and administrative overhead.

wrongOptionNotes.A: Disabling the tool entirely solves the budget constraint by removing productivity value, which contradicts the business objective of optimizing productivity while managing costs.
wrongOptionNotes.B: Maintaining disparate subscriptions creates administrative complexity and fails to leverage enterprise volume efficiencies or centralized management.
wrongOptionNotes.D: Individual plans do not provide enterprise-grade privacy, content exclusions, or centralized billing management, increasing compliance risk and administrative overhead.
